name: ee_company
description: One Estonian company or other registered entity by its registry code or exact current name, from Estonia's e-Business Register (published as open data by RIK, the Estonian Centre of Registers and Information Systems). Returns identity (name, legal form, VAT number), registration status (registered/in liquidation/bankrupt), address, and currently reported EMTAK/NACE activity areas. Use for "what is the status of registry code 12417834" or "look up Bolt Technology OÜ". A company's CURRENT registered name is matched exactly -- a FORMER name (e.g. a company later renamed) will not match by name; look it up by registry code instead if known. For partial name matches use ee_company_search first.

name.description: Exact current registered name, e.g. "Bolt Technology OÜ". Case/diacritic-insensitive (works with or without õ/ä/ö/ü). Use ee_company_search for partial names.

name: ee_company_search
description: Search Estonia's e-Business Register (RIK open data) by the start of a company's current name, optionally filtered by registration status (registered, liquidation or bankrupt; any other value is refused, not ignored). Prefix match first ("Bolt" finds "Bolt Technology OÜ" but not "EuroBolt OÜ"); only when nothing starts with the text does it fall back to a weaker contains-the-text pass and report match_mode:'substring'; diacritic-insensitive, so plain-ASCII and Estonian spellings both work; the legal form is optional and can sit either side ("Tallinna Sadam", "Tallinna Sadam AS" and "AS Tallinna Sadam" all find "aktsiaselts TALLINNA SADAM"), and the company whose name matches exactly apart from its legal form is listed first. Use for "find Estonian companies named Bolt..." or to get a registry code to pass to ee_company.

name.description: Start of the company's current registered name, e.g. "Bolt".

status.description: Filter by registration status. "active" is a synonym for "registered". Case-insensitive; any other value is refused with the valid list.

name: ee_annual_report_stats
description: Selected financial indicators and sales-by-activity breakdowns from an Estonian entity's filed annual reports (RIK's monthly open-data extracts of e-Business Register annual reports) -- NOT full reports. Pass registry_code alone to list every year with a filed report (submission date, audited flag, filer-size category); add year for that year's figures: revenue, profit/loss, total assets, equity, average full-time-equivalent employee count, and sales revenue broken down by EMTAK activity area. Some filed reports carry metadata but no matching figures in RIK's extract (seen for some large/group filers) -- the report row still answers, with null figures.

year.description: Report year, e.g. "2024". Omit to list every year with a filed report.

name: ee_beneficial_owners
description: An Estonian entity's beneficial owners (Estonia's e-Business Register, published by RIK, the Estonian Centre of Registers and Information Systems) by registry code or exact current name: each owner's name, date of birth and nationality EXACTLY as the register itself shows them, the manner in which control is exercised (direct/indirect ownership etc.), and the start date of that holding. RIK marks this data as informative rather than authoritative, and the register carries no live per-record API for it -- this tool reads the register's own public company page, live, per request, so data_as_of reflects RIK's own last-updated date for the beneficial-owners section specifically. Anyone named here can request removal at support@pipeworx.io; a removal already on file is silently withheld and counted in withheld_by_removal_request.

name.description: Exact current registered name. Use ee_company_search first for a partial match, or pass registry_code directly if known.
